subject.title: feat(macos): Quick Chat streamed replies and continue-recent targeting

question: Should macOS Quick Chat permanently expand from a fire-and-forget composer into an in-panel transcript with selectable recent-session routing?
rationale: This PR introduces a new persistent interaction model and target-selection behavior rather than repairing an established broken contract; the protected maintainer label requires explicit owner judgment.

options.title: Sponsor the Quick Chat expansion
options.body: Confirm the embedded transcript and recent-session targeting as the supported macOS Quick Chat direction, contingent on source review and live proof.

options.title: Keep Quick Chat composer-only
options.body: Reject the expanded transcript and routing scope, retaining the existing full-chat-window workflow for replies and conversation selection.

options.title: Narrow the feature
options.body: Accept streamed in-panel replies but defer recent-session targeting to a separately designed macOS interaction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the Quick Chat expansion
recommendation.body: Confirm the embedded transcript and recent-session targeting as the supported macOS Quick Chat direction, contingent on source review and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author is the only evidenced person connected to this specific proposed macOS Quick Chat design; current-main ownership could not be verified in the read-only environment.
